Learned mode representation pilot — experiment 1

Incremental training report. This single HTML embeds figures, example audio and linked settings/tables. Click Load embedded audio in current Chrome/Edge. Shared model assets and checkpoints are stored separately in the run directory.

First learned-representation arm: PCA basis versus shared sine/SnakeBeta conditional function decoders. Decoder weights are shared assets, not transmitted anew per mode. Means and RMS gains are two transmitted scalars per component. Latent prefixes are explicit budgets; no quantization, RVQ, stitching or learned decomposition.

Speaker-disjoint local LibriSpeech train/validation/test sets, frozen before fitting. Test is evaluated only after selecting checkpoints by mean validation block NMSE across budgets. Training uses normalized component waveform MSE with a small code-norm regularizer. This pilot is not the complete symbolic-function search or proof of the best possible representation.

Both neural decoders have identical trainable time-frequency features, FiLM conditioning and capacity; their hidden activations differ. Prefix masking trains budgets jointly. The uncentered PCA/SVD basis is the optimal training-set through-origin linear subspace for normalized components, not necessarily optimal for held-out block error. Actual per-block counts include all modes and the residual. Float32 JSON payload size and shared decoder storage are reported separately; scalar counts do not establish a bitrate.

40 ms distortion metrics are waveform/spectral diagnostics, not validated perceptual speech scores. No PESQ/STOI is computed. Curves use validation until a model finishes, then test points are explicitly labeled.
